headline: How To Earn $500 A Month From ConocoPhillips Stock Ahead Of Q2 Earnings
summary: ConocoPhillips (COP) to release Q2 earnings on Aug 6. Analysts expect $2.89/share, up from $1.42 last year. Recent acquisition of BP ECKL also in news.

headline: Suncor CEO says ‘a lot of work to do’ on pipeline, carbon MOU
summary: Suncor Energy tripled profits in the spring quarter to $3.7 billion, allowing it to boost shareholder rewards and more than double royalties
